answers.how: The ball diameter is about 74 pixels. Around 0.5 s, its center moves about 44 pixels in 0.20 s, giving (44/0.20) × (2/74).
Tracking the leftmost ball just after impact gives a local speed of about 12 pixels/s. Using the 74-pixel diameter, its speed is 12 × (2/74).
